name: Web Development
short_description: Apps and portals that connect to your existing systems.
description: Custom web applications for business operations: enquiry portals, customer self-service, internal dashboards and admin tools. We build the parts that connect to your existing systems, and we handle the integration work rather than handing you an API and wishing you luck.

name: Mobile App Development
short_description: Field and customer apps that work away from a desk.
description: iOS and Android apps for field teams, customers and internal workflows. Typically worth building when staff need to capture or look up information away from a desk — inspections, order entry, approvals, site surveys — and the existing web tool is not usable on a phone.

name: AI Automation
short_description: One measurable process automated at a time.
description: AI automation applied to one measurable process at a time: document intake, enquiry routing, data entry, reconciliation or reporting. We map the current flow, build the automated step against your real data, and keep a human review point wherever the output carries commercial risk.

name: Agentic AI
short_description: Model-planned systems for work whose steps genuinely vary.
description: Multi-step systems where a model plans and calls tools rather than following a fixed script. Appropriate when the steps genuinely vary between cases. We scope these narrowly, because open-ended agents fail in ways that are hard to observe and harder to recover from.

name: AI Agents
short_description: A single-purpose agent for one defined task.
description: A single-purpose agent that handles a defined task end to end: answering questions over your own documents, triaging inbound requests, drafting a response for review, or looking up records across systems. Deployed with logging and a fallback path, not as a black box.

name: Machine Learning
short_description: Custom models with a baseline you can measure against.
description: Custom models for prediction, classification, ranking and anomaly detection, built when a rule-based approach has stopped working. We start with a baseline and a held-out test set, so the gain is measurable before anything goes to production.

name: Data Science
short_description: Analysis aimed at a decision, not a dashboard.
description: Analysis aimed at a decision: which products lose margin, where a process actually breaks, what drives churn. We work from your operational data, state the assumptions, and report what the data does not support as clearly as what it does.

name: Power BI
short_description: Reports you act on, with defined measures.
description: Power BI reports and dashboards built on your existing data sources, with defined measures and a documented refresh model. The goal is a report someone opens on a Monday morning and acts on, not a wall of charts nobody trusts.

name: Analytics & Reporting
description: Reporting pipelines and recurring analysis where the output is currently assembled by hand each week or month. We automate the assembly and keep the definitions of each measure written down, so two reports cannot quietly disagree.

name: AI Consulting
short_description: A fixed-scope assessment of what is worth automating.
description: A short, fixed-scope assessment: which processes are worth automating, what data exists, what the constraints are, and what it would take. You get a prioritised plan with effort and risk per item. We will tell you when the answer is not to use AI.

name: Cloud Deployment
short_description: Infrastructure sized to what the app actually uses.
description: Deployment for the systems we build: containerised services, managed databases, secret handling, backups and monitoring. Scoped to what the application actually needs, so you are not paying for infrastructure the workload does not use.

name: MLOps
short_description: Evaluation, monitoring and rollback for a model in production.
description: The operational layer around a model in production: versioned prompts and artefacts, evaluation runs, drift and failure monitoring, and a rollback path. Needed once a model is load-bearing and a silent regression would reach customers.
